entities.name: Henrique Lopes de Mendonça
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Henrique Lopes de Mendonça was a Portuguese poet, playwright, novelist, novella and short story writer, and naval officer. He wrote several plays, and with his friend, the composer Alfredo Keil, he wrote the lyrics of the future Portuguese national anthem, A Portuguesa, which was officially adopted in 1911.
